description: PROP-I1 integration test does NOT actually exercise the snapshot-diff against a populated ~/loops/gig/ directory. When LOOPS_DIR does not exist (= the documented pre-#27 state per manifest, and the state shown by live E2E), _snapshot_mtimes() returns {} both before and after, so the assertion `before == after` becomes `{} == {}` and is trivially satisfied. The test will NOT catch a regression where the shim modifies an EXISTING file under ~/loops/gig/ (only a brand-new first-ever file creation would be caught). The manifest's extraConstraint #1 explicitly demands: 'verify the integration test ACTUALLY exercises this (= the snapshot logic catches a regression, not just happy path).' The test needs to seed ~/loops/gig/ with at least one fixture file (e.g. write a sentinel under a tmp HOME or under ~/loops/gig/state/.snapshot-sentinel), snapshot, run shim, snapshot, and assert mtimes are identical. As written, REQ-I1 / PROP-I1 is unverified in the configuration the live system is actually in.
